brief: Prioritize Langmere Dale 230/34kV for pre-event attention because its advanced age of 34 years and history of high loading reduce its margin against mechanical failure under heat exposure (MG-023). Because this unit uses ONAN cooling, the forced cooling provisions in MG-021 and MG-025 do not apply for fan management. Where the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure (MG-023).
